zh: 每个箱子的耗时都是固定的，彼此之间没有任何共享或取舍：它只取决于箱子所在的楼层。
楼层 i（从 0 开始编号，顶层为 n）上的每个箱子需要一次往返 2(n−i) 分钟，再加 1 分钟装卸，所以总时间就是 boxes[i]×(2(n−i)+1) 的总和。
一次线性扫描累加即可。注意数值范围：箱子数可达 10^9、系数可达约 2×10^5，总和最高约 10^19，超过有符号 64 位整数上限，要用无符号 64 位（或大整数）来累加并输出。
en: Each box costs a fixed amount of time with nothing shared or traded off between boxes: it depends only on the floor the box is on.

Every box on floor i (numbered from 0, with the top floor being n) needs a round trip of 2(n - i) minutes plus 1 minute for loading and unloading, so the total is the sum of boxes[i] * (2(n - i) + 1).

A single linear pass that accumulates this sum is enough. Watch the range: a floor can hold 10^9 boxes and the factor can be about 2 * 10^5, so the total can reach about 10^19, above the signed 64-bit limit; accumulate and print with an unsigned 64-bit integer (or a big integer).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Each box on floor i takes `2(n−i)` minutes for the round trip plus 1 minute for loading and unloading, so the costs simply add up linearly. Time O(n), constant extra space.

## Proof of correctness

Every box on floor i must make one round trip from that floor to the top floor and back, taking `2(n−i)`, plus 1 minute of loading and unloading. Round trips of different boxes share nothing, so adding up all these fixed costs gives the unique total time, which is also the minimum time.

## Complexity

Each trip visits only one floor and then returns to the top floor; boxes may repeat round trips any number of times.

O(n) time, O(1) extra space.

## Reference implementation

```python
def solve(raw):
 z=list(map(int,raw.split()));n=z[0];a=z[1:1+n];return str(sum(b*(2*(n-i)+1) for i,b in enumerate(a)))
```
